{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABZkkO4w", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhDLJsg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 95, "title": "Implement V30 ADD4S packed-BCD string addition", "body": "## Problem

The VM profile rejects the documented V30 ADD4S instruction. Its `0F` decoder implements bit operations and memory nibble rotations but falls through to `unsupported V30 opcode 0F 20` for ADD4S. This leaves packed-decimal arithmetic unavailable to DOS software using the V30 instruction set.

Evidence: [VM decoder](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/b8a7e415ee9758fc3b8ed2f73c78740d421f30df/src/cpu.rs#L1816), [existing V30 tests](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/b8a7e415ee9758fc3b8ed2f73c78740d421f30df/tests/core.rs#L1409). Static inspection found no ADD4S implementation, focused tests or guest probe. The supplied context contains no open Issue covering it.

## Expected outcome

Implement ADD4S on Pc9801Vm for valid packed-BCD operands throughout its documented digit-count range.

The hardware contract is:

- `0F 20` is two bytes, without ModR/M. Add the little-endian packed-BCD source at DS:SI, with source segment override permitted, to the destination at fixed ES:DI.
- CL specifies 1–254 digits. Process `ceil(CL/2)` bytes, including both digits of the final byte for odd CL.
- Ignore incoming CF, propagate decimal carry, set CF for overflow beyond the rounded width, and set ZF for an all-zero rounded result. AF/OF/PF/SF are undefined.

Source: [NEC V-Series Instruction Manual, printed pp.15–16](https://www.ardent-tool.com/CPU/docs/NEC/V20-V30/v_series.pdf#page=26).

Interpretation of NEC's operation and byte-offset diagram: traverse increasing offsets while preserving SI, DI and CL; DF does not reverse this operation. NEC describes DIR-controlled traversal separately for block transfer/I/O instructions in [Appendix A.4(9)](https://www.ardent-tool.com/CPU/docs/NEC/V20-V30/v_series.pdf#page=200). Preserve other registers and control flags. Clearly distinguish this interpretation and any deterministic undefined-flag policy from explicit hardware guarantees.

Scope is this instruction and its focused acceptance. SUB4S, CMP4S, bit-field extensions, register nibble rotations, TF traps, NMI and broader V30 flags/prefix/interrupt/fault coverage remain outstanding. CL=0/255, nondecimal nibbles, partially overlapping buffers, new REP/LOCK semantics, interruption within ADD4S and exact instruction timing are outside this Issue's verified subset; document their limitations without removing them from future inventory work.

## Context and reproduction

Evaluation baseline: `b8a7e415ee9758fc3b8ed2f73c78740d421f30df`.

A minimal original reproduction can set DS=ES=0, SI=2000h, DI=3000h, CL=2, source byte=09h and destination byte=01h, then execute `0F 20 90`. Currently ADD4S returns the unsupported diagnostic. Expected destination is 10h, CF=ZF=0, followed by execution of the NOP without consuming it as an operand.

Reuse the existing [CPU memory helpers](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/b8a7e415ee9758fc3b8ed2f73c78740d421f30df/src/cpu.rs#L235) and [Bus mapping](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/b8a7e415ee9758fc3b8ed2f73c78740d421f30df/src/bus.rs#L157); direct backing-memory access would bypass ROM protection and VRAM behavior. Keep the separate Ap extended-opcode decoder intact: on Ap, these bytes belong to the i486 control-register instruction family.

Progress assessment: PR #94's production delta implements the bounded PIT mode-4 behavior described in the supplied report. The Coordinator reports 14 focused tests, 377 native tests and 134 production release-Wasm browser cases passing. The default-port browser attempt executed zero cases; the reported alternate-port run preserved both hosting roots and existing assertions. See [committed validation](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/b8a7e415ee9758fc3b8ed2f73c78740d421f30df/docs/validation.md#issue-93-8253-binary-mode-4-2026-10-24) and [PR #94](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/pull/94). This evaluator read source, the production diff and reports; it executed no builds/tests and prepared no fixtures. No independent review or remote CI result was supplied.

All 26 inventory scopes and statuses remain unchanged: 24 partial, GRCG implemented_unverified and paging unimplemented; none verified. Protected execution, paging and basic numerical x87 remain required. Missing local fixtures do not block this planning decision. Bounded probes and six-game reports establish neither complete hardware accuracy nor commercial compatibility.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add the original minimal reproduction before changing production behavior. Record its baseline failure and unchanged post-change pass.
- [ ] Implement the specified VM instruction through existing mapped memory access. Preserve instruction boundaries, registers and control flags; do not route Ap execution through the V30 implementation.
- [ ] Add `v30_add4s_` Rust tests using an independent decimal-digit or base-100 oracle, rather than copying production adjustment formulas. Exhaust all 100×100 valid one-byte operand pairs; exercise both incoming CF states and varied initial flags/CH. Cover every documented CL value with deterministic patterns, long carry chains, carry termination, leading zeros, and results whose last byte alone cannot determine ZF. Avoid host integer overflow for long operands.
- [ ] Include literal distinguishing cases: CL=4, 9999+0001 produces 0000 with CF=ZF=1; CL=3, 0999+0001 produces 1000 with CF=ZF=0. Include an odd-count case with a nonzero extra high digit so masking it away fails acceptance. Assert only defined status flags as architectural results; label tests of undefined-flag policy separately.
- [ ] Cover default DS and all four source segment overrides using distinct segment contents, fixed destination selection, DF=0/1, preserved SI/DI/CX and unrelated registers, next-instruction progress, disjoint buffers and exact aliasing. Check unchanged disjoint source bytes and immediate destination guards.
- [ ] Test source and destination offset wrapping separately and together, 20-bit physical wrapping, ROM read/write protection and ordinary planar VRAM access with accelerators disabled. Expectations must follow existing Bus mappings; include guards that expose an accidental raw-memory implementation.
- [ ] Add `ap_v30_add4s_` regression coverage showing that Ap retains its existing i486 diagnostic for `0F 20` without V30 arithmetic side effects. Do not describe that emulator limitation as an architectural #UD.
- [ ] Add an original MIT guest probe, suggested paths `guest/v30_add4s.asm`, `tools/prepare_v30_add4s_fixture.py`, `fixtures/v30-add4s-manifest.json` and `tests/browser/v30-add4s.spec.js`. Build it offline from source. Pin license/provenance, assembly command, source/boot/image hashes, literal expected results, masked flags, guards and a finite scheduler budget. Normal preparation must verify the checked manifest without update mode. Keep generated media outside `web/` and add preparation to README and existing CI.
- [ ] Boot the identical probe image on VM natively and in the production release-Wasm artifact, cold and after reset, at both `/` and `/pc98-rust/`. Require exact results/guards, PASS without FAIL, unchanged media and no emulator/browser errors within the pinned budget. Hosts may mount, reset, step and inspect; the guest must execute and check the instruction itself.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs the new preparation command, `cargo test --locked --test core v30_add4s_`, `cargo test --locked --test cpu386 ap_v30_add4s_`, and the repository's documented lawful fixture preparation and full checks: `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `git diff --check`, and `npm test` after documented browser prerequisites. An occupied-port workaround may change only serving ports/path resolution while preserving both projects, assertions and budgets; disclose failed attempts separately.
- [ ] Preserve existing V30, Ap, PIT/PIC/timer, memory/graphics, DOS/apps, VM, audio/storage and browser regressions. Retain existing six-game assertions, budgets and reports as supporting evidence. Require no new commercial software or proprietary ROM acquisition and no copied emulator implementation.
- [ ] Update focused hardware coverage and validation documentation with exact Coordinator/CI results, failures and limitations. Keep V30 partial and retain every other inventory category's scope and status. Review and resolve concrete findings before merge; do not substitute these probes for full CPU or commercial-compatibility claims.

## Optional validation

None.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
